name: Qitdlarssuaq's migration
traveler: Qitdlarssuaq and about forty Inuit of Baffin Island
summary: A shaman leads a band of Baffin Island Inuit north by sledge across Lancaster Sound and Ellesmere Island to Greenland, guided by a vision and by reports from a British ship of people living there. The Polar Inuit they find had lost the kayak and the bow; the newcomers bring them back.

stops.note: After a killing feud, Qitdlarssuaq and his people leave the south of Baffin Island.
North along Baffin Island, where they hear from whalers of people across the sea.
Across Lancaster Sound on the ice.
Two winters on the way; some turn back.
Across Smith Sound to the Polar Inuit, who learn again to build kayaks and hunt with the bow.
